data_fields.name: bag_volume
data_fields.donor_constant: container's own shape volume (one byte from wgtvol.dat); 0 = no limit

best_idea: Make every carry and drop check exact and enforced in the one ledger add, return the part that fitted (clamp-and-report), and lift an item out only as a transaction that puts it back on refusal.
decision_why: Keep the clamp-and-report weight fit, the bag-volume-as-own-size rule and the lift-then-put-back transaction, but fix the integer fit, the 0.9-stone drag tolerance and the single-add path that skips weight, and enforce every cap in the ledger add rather than the drag UI.
acceptance: Drag 7 coins onto a bag with 1 tenth free: exactly the units that fit by exact weight move (3 in the constructed case), the rest stay in the source, and a server test asserts ledger weight never exceeds the cap after any add, drop or put-back.
